name: Financial and investment analyst
description: Answers for APQC process group 1.4, Develop and maintain business models: models how the venture creates, delivers and captures value from pricing, cost and customer evidence, keeps the model current as evidence changes, and proposes how changes to it are governed. A person adopts a business model.
